IN THE ISSUE OF DUE DILIGENCE IN SAN FRANCISCO COUNTY
This jurisdiction holds that reasonable diligence requires that there be attempt at personal
service on at least three separate calendar day. At least one of these attempts must be
made at the residence address, if known. If the residence address is unknown, the
declarant must so state. The attempts on the calendar days should be made a time when
the person might be home regardless of his or her work schedule which might be day
shift, swing shift or night shift. These attempts might also take into consideration that
commute time might be involved before and after work. This, if a person works the day
shift between 8:00am and 5:00pm, service might be attempted before 7:00am or after
6:00pm. If a person works the swing shift between 3:00pm and 12:00 midnight, service
might be attempted in the early afternoon. If plaintiff is ignorant of both the residence
address and the works schedule of defendant reasonable attempts should be made to serve
the defendant in the early morning, midmorning, and early afternoon and/or after dinner,
at his place of his business (see worksheet below). There must be a declaration of due
diligence submitted with the proof of service stating that there were such attempts at
personal service before substituted service was made, the server having taken into
consideration the 3 possible works shifts. At a business where direct contact with an
employee in not permitted the process server may make substitute service without the
prior attempts, but it must be stated on the proof of service that company policy does not
allow personal service and also the defendant’s residence is unknown. If the residence
address is known attempts must be made there before service can be completed at the |
business. AGAIN, if the plaintiff is ignorant of the residence address of the defendant,
this fact must appear in any “due diligence” declaration. Providing the various work
shifts have been taken into consideration, the sub-service may be affected on the third
attempt.
